attributes.originalText: 各位同学大家好： 欢迎大家选修本学期的《形式语言与自动机》课程。我们的上课时间是每周二第二大节（09:50-12:15），地点是五教5201。为了良好的教学秩序与学习效果，在此就一些重要的问题加以说明，请大家知悉： 1. 本课程要求大家到教室线下上课。如临时因故无法到教室上课的，请提前向助教请假（详见第三条）；除因突发生病外，不接受事后请假。 2. 本课程以PPT授课为主，不要求大家准备教材。 3. 如有问题需要联系助教（包括但不限于请假、补交作业、请求答疑等），请通过微信或邮件与助教联系： 赵乙宁 zhaoyn22@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn 微信群中第一个 4. 本课程的考核方式包括课堂参与、小作业、编程实验、期中随堂小测和期末闭卷考试，并可选参加慕课考试。成绩以等级制给出。具体的评分标准细则将由老师在第一节课上给出。 5. 为了方便大家与老师、助教的沟通，进行答疑等活动，请大家扫下面的二维码加入我们的课程微信群，并在进群后将群内昵称修改为自己的姓名。如发现二维码过期或无法扫描等情况，请邮件联系助教(zhaoyn22@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn)申请加入。 期待大家的到来！

attributes.originalText: Dear all, Welcome to this course! I'm truly excited to work with each of you in the coming semester. I am confident that with your consistent effort and my guidance, you will make remarkable progress in your English listening and speaking skills, and gradually build greater confidence in using English effectively. In this course, I will also help you refine your understanding of how to use English appropriately as a Tsinghua student, which is essential for your future academic and professional development. I have already uploaded the listening and speaking materials (MP3/MP4) we will use this semester on our Web‑School platform. Textbooks will be distributed to you in class. A gentle reminder: Please check and update your contact information (phone number and email address) on our Web‑School platform if necessary, so that I can reach you individually when needed. I hope you will enjoy this course and I'm looking forward to a productive semester with all of you. Weimin ---------------------------------- Weimin Zhang, PhD Professor of Applied Linguistics Tsinghua University Email: zhangwm2024@qq.com Mobile: 13020047216
